note: The one place the page-weight and JS budgets live, all in KB. A limit is a ceiling to notice a regression by, not a target: lower it when pages get lighter. Read by page-weight.ts and js-budget.ts. pageWeight: the first entry whose match fits a page's path is its budget (the last must match every page); each limit was set from the heaviest page of its kind with about 30% to grow. js: gzipped JavaScript on arrival per kind of page, set from the build of 2026-09-30 with ~10% headroom; the heaviest page of a kind must fit max, and the kind's median page median where one is set.
